findings.mechanism: Creating a new httpx.AsyncClient per call opens a separate socket and its own connection pool, causing many simultaneous file descriptors under load, violating the runtime's file descriptor limits (06-file-descriptors). Additionally, each socket incurs a kernel syscall overhead (02-threads-and-syscalls).
findings.remediation: Instantiate a shared httpx.AsyncClient at module level and reuse it for all calls, configuring a reasonable connection pool limit.
findings.arithmetic: Each concurrent call creates its own AsyncClient, which opens at least one socket (1 fd). With N concurrent requests, open_fds = N. For N=200, open_fds = 200, which approaches typical process limits (e.g., 1024).
